nameless.moon_stone: Gently lowers gravity and prevents fall damage. Gravity reduction is 3/8 of the old effect (-0.02625; ordinary gravity becomes 0.05375).
nameless.missing_page: Taking sourced enemy damage releases a 5-block burst for 1 damage plus 10% of your strongest offensive power, capped at 6 per target. 4s interval; no boss-HP scaling.
nameless.eclipse_ashes: Taking an enemy hit summons phantom wolves for 5s, spaced 1s apart. Each deals 1 damage plus 5% of your strongest offensive power, capped at 3. New sessions have a 12s interval; hits do not extend the session.
nameless.resonant_heart: Enemy hits have exactly a 10% chance to trigger a sonic retaliation for 2 damage plus 15% of your strongest offensive power, capped at 8. 6s interval.
nameless.reverse_card: Enemy hits have exactly a 25% chance to reflect 25% of incoming damage. Reflected damage is capped at 2 plus 10% of your strongest offensive power, never above 6. 4s interval; does not cancel the incoming hit.
nameless.vampire_blood: Attack damage +10%; movement speed +10%. Enemy kills heal 2 HP plus 5% of wearer maximum HP, capped at 4 HP, once per 2s. Sunlight damage remains 2 HP. Removal stays locked for 48,000 equipped ticks (two full Minecraft days); offline time and sleep skips do not advance it.
nameless.ghast_eye: Adds 7.5% of maximum HP before the three scaling health accessories and Health Boost, capped at +6 HP. Kills refresh Regeneration I for 5s without adding duration; stronger unrelated regeneration remains.
nameless.woundbearer: Stores 1% of damage taken as extra attack damage. Storage limit is 10% of melee power before Power Glove and Woundbearer, capped at +4 effective attack damage. Decay starts after 3s with base decay 0.01 per tick; legacy storage is clamped.
nameless.rage_mind: Deal +10% damage against the marked creature type; existing marking and range conditions remain.
nameless.fractured_nullstone: Reduces recognized magic damage by 15%, leaving 85% before other defenses.
nameless.blaze_nucleus: Reduces fire damage by 50%; qualifying enemy hits ignite for 4s and extinguish the wearer.
nameless.explosion_proof_jacket: Reduces explosion damage by 20%; awards at most 1 TNT every 20s from qualifying explosion events.
nameless.creeper_sense: Sneaking triggers a power-3 explosion on a 12s cooldown. No block destruction; the wearer can still be hurt. Party allies and their pets are protected.
nameless.four_leaf_clover: Eligible non-player kills have a 25% chance of one extra loot-table roll. Not guaranteed duplication of original drops.
nameless.fate_emerald: Trade discount boost 25 (raw value, not a guaranteed 25% discount). Retains 60s removal lock and 0.1 exhaustion per second.
nameless.sigil_of_baphomet: Kills add 0.5s of damage immunity, banked up to 2s. Stored legacy counts are clamped to the current cap.
nameless.scarab_amulet: Movement on sand +30% (1.3x); husk targeting protection retained.
nameless.titans_mark: Size +25%, attack damage +5%. Adds 15% of maximum HP before the three scaling health accessories and Health Boost, capped at +10 HP. Refreshes Resistance I for 5s and Slowness I for 60s; no healing on equip or refresh.
nameless.tick: Once per second, drains eligible non-player enemies within an 8-block sphere for 1 damage plus 10% strongest offensive power, capped at 6 per target. Targets must have over 50 maximum HP and be above half HP. Each successful pulse costs the wearer 5% maximum HP, or exhaustion equal to 10% current food when below 5 HP. Own and party pets are protected. Normal removal still requires being on fire; creative bypass retained.

artifacts.vampiric_glove: Basic melee hits heal 5% of actual health damage, capped at 2 HP, once per 1s. Overkill and absorption do not increase healing; allies and accessory retaliation cannot trigger it. Healing-received modifiers remain native.
artifacts.power_glove: Adds 5% of melee power before Power Glove and Woundbearer, capped at +2 effective attack damage. Recalculates as outside equipment and buffs change.
artifacts.crystal_heart: Adds 10% of maximum HP before the three scaling health accessories and Health Boost, capped at +8 effective HP. No healing on equip or refresh; cannot amplify the other scaling health curios.
artifacts.cross_necklace: Adds 10 invulnerability ticks (0.5s) after taking damage; native cooldown 5s.
artifacts.running_shoes: +15% base movement speed while sprinting; retains +0.5 block step height.
artifacts.steadfast_spikes: +30% knockback resistance and +1 slip resistance. Fits the restored Feet slot, separate from Nameless Shoes.
artifacts.flame_pendant: 40% chance to ignite an eligible attacker for 4s, granting the wearer Fire Resistance I for 4s. 4s cooldown; allies and accessory retaliation are excluded.
artifacts.shock_pendant: 25% chance to retaliate against an eligible attacker under open sky. Visual lightning accompanies 2 damage plus 10% of strongest offensive power, capped at 6. 6s cooldown. Retains lightning immunity; no collateral lightning damage or fire.
artifacts.withered_bracelet: Melee hits have a 30% chance to apply Wither I for 4s. 4s cooldown shared by the wearer; excludes allies and accessory retaliation.
artifacts.thorn_pendant: 50% chance to retaliate for 1 damage plus 10% wearer armor, capped at 4 damage. Fixed 4s interval; excludes allies and cannot trigger retaliation chains.
artifacts.chorus_totem: Consumed death protection: clears effects, attempts a teleport within 32 blocks and restores 25% of current maximum HP, capped at 16 HP. Native rescue consumption and other effects remain.
